name: LLM Engineering
description: Build with large language models: tokenization, embeddings, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, agents and production LLM systems.

items.title: Hugging Face NLP Course
items.description: Transformers, fine-tuning and LLM fundamentals with hands-on code.

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.description: The Transformer paper that made modern LLMs possible.

items.title: DeepLearning.AI Short Courses
items.description: Practical LLM engineering courses from industry experts.

items.title: OpenAI Documentation

lessons.title: What Is LLM Engineering?
lessons.description: The discipline of building systems on top of large language models — and where it differs from classic ML.

lessons.title: LLM Architecture Review
lessons.description: Decoder-only transformers, context windows, and what happens inside a single generation call.

lessons.title: Working with LLM APIs
lessons.description: Chat completions, parameters, streaming and structured outputs — the daily API toolkit.

lessons.title: Prompting Systems at Scale
lessons.description: Turn prompts into versioned, testable system components — not strings in code.

lessons.title: Tokenization & Context Management
lessons.description: Budget tokens, count costs, and fit big context into small windows.

lessons.title: Embeddings & Semantic Search
lessons.description: Turn text into vectors and search by meaning — the retrieval backbone of LLM apps.

lessons.title: RAG Engineering
lessons.description: Design retrieval-augmented generation that is reliable: chunking, indexing and prompting.

lessons.title: Advanced RAG
lessons.description: Hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting and contextual compression for better answers.

lessons.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs in Practice
lessons.description: LoRA, QLoRA and instruction tuning — adapt open models when prompting is not enough.

lessons.title: Function Calling & Structured Outputs
lessons.description: Let the model call your tools with typed arguments — reliably.

lessons.title: Building LLM Agents
lessons.description: Connect models to tools and loops: the agent pattern in production.

lessons.title: Context Engineering & Memory
lessons.description: Manage what the model sees: conversation memory, summarization and caching.

lessons.title: Evaluating LLM Systems
lessons.description: Build evals that catch regressions: golden sets, LLM-as-judge and human review.

lessons.title: Guardrails & Safety for LLM Apps
lessons.description: Prompt injection, moderation, PII redaction and output filtering.

lessons.title: LLM Serving & Inference
lessons.description: Serve open models: vLLM, quantization, batching and GPU memory management.

lessons.title: Cost Optimization for LLM Apps
lessons.description: Cut spend without cutting quality: caching, smaller models, and smart routing.

lessons.title: Prompt Versioning & Observability
lessons.description: Trace every request: prompt, tokens, latency, cost and outcome.

lessons.title: Building a Production Copilot
lessons.description: Assemble everything into a real product: an assistant grounded in your data.

lessons.title: LLM Production Case Studies
lessons.description: Learn from real systems: search copilots, support agents and coding assistants.

lessons.title: The LLMOps Tooling Landscape
lessons.description: Survey the ecosystem: frameworks, eval platforms, observability and serving.

lessons.title: LLM Engineering Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course into a plan: build, ship and scale LLM products.
